text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I catch Vodka spying on<n>other students,
scribbling away in a<n>notebook...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I understand how you feel, but I<n>wouldn't agonize
over it too much.<n>The worst thing you can do here is
psych yourself out of doing what<n>needs to be done.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right... Thanks for the<n>help. I'll ask for
advice sooner if I get<n>stuck like that again!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's so dark, I can't make anything<n>out clearly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Vodka's back at it,<n>spying on Agnes
Tachyon's lab.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, another failure.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Excellent, I can check that off the list<n>of
possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm one step closer to success.<n>Don't you agree,
my covert visitor?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? M-me? I wasn't spyin' on you<n>or anythin'! I
was just, uh... Um...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You were just hoping to help with my<n>research, no?
I'm glad you<n>volunteered.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Volun... wait. Wait, I-I never said<n>anything about that!
choice_data_list: There you are, Vodka. We've gotta get to training.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? But we don't have...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Y-yeah! Training, right! We totally<n>have training
today! Right now! No<n>time to volunteer, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whew, you're a lifesaver, Trainer. I<n>thought I was
done for...
choice_data_list: Why were you taking notes on Tachyon anyways?
Why were you taking notes on Tachyon anyways?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, I was just talkin' to Scarlet the<n>other day, and...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeesh. You wouldn't know "cool" if ithit you over the head. Cool is whatyou call people like Brian or Big G.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
They're lone wolves, makin' their<n>own paths. That
cold confidence of<n>theirs is just the coolest!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I swear, you are so simple-minded.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Coolness is more nuanced. Like Air<n>Groove or
Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And that's how we ended up arguing<n>over which of
the older students were<n>coolest.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It kinda got me thinkin', though. I've<n>never really
tried to look at Air Groove<n>or Tachyon as "cool."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So I figured I'd watch 'em in action<n>before I made
any judgments,<n>y'know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as I'm thinking that's a mature<n>way to bury
the argument, I catch<n>sight of a certain someone
who<n>seems to have reached the same<n>conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wow... I never knew Brian had a side<n>like that to
her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: N-not that I care what you considercool, though! I just spotted her bycoincidence and was having a look, isall.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A-anyways... what did you think of Air<n>Groove and
Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I mean, I dunno what you of all peoplethink bein' cool means, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Uh, I guess Air Groove really looks<n>after others, and
Tachyon turns<n>failures into progress.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So I can see why you'd think they're<n>cool, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
After watching Brian and Gimlet for a<n>little while, I
also could kinda see it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Why you would look up to them, I<n>mean.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh. So basically...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The older students are all super cool!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh... That's quite theoversimplification.
choice_data_list: Now I'm gonna have to work hard to be cool too!
Now I'm gonna have to work hard to be cool too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh... That's quite theoversimplification.
choice_data_list: Now I'm gonna have to work hard to be cool too!
Now I'm gonna have to work hard to be cool too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: On a superficial level, maybe.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Aw, c'mon, it's coolness, not rocket<n>science. Cool
is cool!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: At the very least, I have more respectfor the older students than that!Lumping everything together as "cool" is so shallow!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Why? You got somethin' against<n>callin' cool people
cool?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bam!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Stop making a racket! We can hear<n>you from inside
the student council<n>room!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Idiots.

text_block_list.name: Vodka & Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Whoops, sorry, guys! Oh no, I'm so<n>sorry!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sometimes, I think it would actually killthe two of you to get along... C'mon,into the council room with you both.You're not leaving until you have asnack and calm down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Just shut up and have<n>something sweet.
That'll fix things.

text_block_list.name: Vodka & Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Um, thanks?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Air Groove and Brian drag<n>their juniors
away and shower them<n>in treats.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey now, you're already cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You always know exactly how to<n>make my running
better, and you're<n>super smart! And you always
work<n>super hard! You're the coolest!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how you rattle all that<n>mushy praise
off with a straight<n>face...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Mushy? Wh-what do you mean<n>mushy?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-I didn't... I didn't mean it like that!<n>Quit makin'
things weird!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pair continue the spirited chat for<n>a good long
while. The way they<n>adore their role models shows
they<n>really are on the same wavelength. ♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka & Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Take! That! Back!
